Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview.
Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee SRF Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) is conducting this recruitment drive for various positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is SRF (Senior Research Fellow).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the SRF post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the SRF post in this IIT Roorkee recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for IIT Roorkee SRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walkin, meaning candidates need to attend an interview directly.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply or the walk-in date for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and last date to apply is 14 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.E./M.Tech in Microelectronics/VLSI or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the SRF position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the SRF position is Rs. 42000/- per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the SRF post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the SRF post includes an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the "Important Links" section of this article.
